title: 谷歌为 Anthropic 190 亿美元数据中心项目提供信用护航
content:
The competitive landscape in the AI race is becoming increasingly nuanced and tightly interconnected. Data center operator TeraWulf recently announced that it has reached a major credit support agreement with Google to provide strong financing backing specifically for a large data center project in Kentucky leased by AI company Anthropic. It is reported that Anthropic had previously signed a long-term lease of up to 20 years with relevant parties, with a total contract value of approximately $19 billion.
Robust risk backstop and exit mechanism
As a core pillar of the project's financing structure, the credit support provided by Google includes clear risk-hedging and rights-protection provisions.
Under the agreement, if Anthropic defaults on rent or enters bankruptcy proceedings in the future, Google will have flexible discretion: it may either take over the long-term lease directly itself, or choose to pay the applicable termination fee and, in turn, acquire equity in the project company.
At the same time, this credit guarantee is not permanently binding. The agreement sets clear release conditions—once Anthropic or its affiliates that provide guarantees successfully obtain an investment-grade rating and maintain it steadily for at least three months, the credit support may be formally terminated in accordance with the terms.
Plans for ultra-large-scale computing capacity, with first facilities expected to come online in 2027
In terms of specific project scale and delivery schedule, the data center campus demonstrates exceptionally high specifications.
According to publicly disclosed plans, the campus's total computing capacity will reach approximately 401 megawatts (MW), providing ample compute support for the training and inference of large-scale frontier AI models. In terms of construction progress, the first batch of infrastructure is expected to officially enter service in the second half of 2027, fully meeting the massive and continuously surging demand for high-performance computing (HPC) in the AI industry.

report.summary: 谷歌为Anthropic 190亿美元数据中心项目提供信用担保
report.background: AI算力竞赛正从模型能力延伸到资本、能源与数据中心绑定。Anthropic此前与TeraWulf等方签署最长20年、总值约190亿美元的数据中心租约，谷歌此次提供信用支持，帮助项目获得融资并降低违约风险；该园区规划约401MW算力，首批设施预计2027年下半年投运。
key_points: 谷歌提供信用兜底：若Anthropic未来拖欠租金或破产，谷歌可接管长期租约，或支付终止费并取得项目公司股权。
担保设有退出条件：当Anthropic或其担保关联方获得投资级评级并稳定维持至少3个月，信用支持可按条款终止。
项目规格极高：数据中心园区总算力约401MW，主要服务前沿大模型训练与推理，首批设施计划2027年下半年上线。
交易凸显深度绑定：20年租约总值约190亿美元，TeraWulf负责数据中心运营，AI公司正与电力和算力基础设施形成长期联盟。
report.impact: 对AI行业，这意味着头部模型公司将竞争门槛推向资本、能源和云生态联盟；对开发者，长期算力供给预期增强，但需关注云成本与供应商锁定；对普通用户，未来模型服务能力有望提升，但基础设施成本可能间接传导。
report.tools: 可关注TeraWulf项目与财报公告、Anthropic Claude API、Google Cloud Vertex AI；开源侧可用vLLM、Ray了解算力调度与推理部署。
